headline: Will Native Shopify Integration Expand DoorDash's (DASH) Local Retail Reach Enough to Shift Its Narrative?
summary: In July 2026, Shopify Inc. announced that DoorDash Inc. is now available as a native sales channel in Shopify’s App Store, allowing eligible U.S. brick‑and‑mortar merchants to sync catalogs and inventory automatically and start selling on DoorDash in days without changing their existing workflows.
